input.targetRef: Mock Interview setup surface — reconstruct — progress-home

adversarialProbes.attempt: Render the wide viewport baseline.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Horizontal overflow, overexpansion, or lost region ownership.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Render one pixel below the intermediate utility breakpoint.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Controls disappear or composition collapses at the breakpoint edge.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Increase effective scale to 125 percent.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Text or controls clip, overlap, or become unreachable.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Reduce effective scale to 80 percent.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Hierarchy or grouping becomes incoherent.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Restore effective scale to baseline.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Residual displacement or stale responsive state remains.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the document scroll start.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Primary identity or task entry is hidden.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the middle document position.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Cards collide, clip, or lose readable grouping.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the document terminal position.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: The page ending is unreachable or obscured.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Return document scroll to its start.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Scroll restoration leaves stale displacement.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Open the course drawer at bounded-scroll start.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Drawer contents begin clipped or controls are obscured.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Scroll the drawer-owned list to its limit.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Terminal drawer destinations cannot be reached.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Restore the drawer-owned list to its start.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Bounded scroll fails to restore cleanly.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Render long English copy at compact width.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Copy crosses boundaries, clips, or destroys hierarchy.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Render sparse short-content statistics state.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Sparse content creates meaningless structure or dead controls.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the first skeleton presentation before data settles.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Skeleton geometry collapses or invents content.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the history-owned loading presentation independently.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Loading ownership is unclear or confused with steady content.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the settled overview after loading.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Settled content conflicts with prior state or remains placeholder-like.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the compact host without an overlay.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Fixed or sticky chrome occludes the task at baseline.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Open the course-navigation overlay.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Scrim, drawer, close target, or foreground ownership fails.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Attempt to identify a draggable target.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: A required drag interaction is absent from evidence.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Move focus by keyboard onto the History tab.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Focus is invisible, clipped, or obscures the label.

adversarialProbes.attempt: Capture the exact host with page parents, siblings, terminal edge, and no viewport override.
adversarialProbes.expectedFailure: Neighboring shell regions collide or the host handoff cannot be proven.
